**Date:** 2026-03-08

## NVIDIA Partnership & Embodied AI

**Key Developments:**
- **Luxonis Vision Stack Partnership** – Pollen Robotics' Reachy 2 uses the Luxonis OAK FFC-4P for "human-like" vision with 64mm stereo baseline (true human eye distance). Features include on-device stereo rectification & compression with 125ms total latency. This is moving Reachy 2 from teleoperation toward true autonomy.
- **Embodied AI Progress** – Pollen is actively redefining embodied AI, focusing on seamless VR teleoperation as a bridge to autonomous behavior.

---

## Neue Integrationen & Tools

**New Integrations:**
- **AIFlow Labs Integration** – @AIFlow_ML announced "full support to play with the @pollenrobotics Reachy Mini" (March 6), suggesting a new software platform/integration layer.
- **VR Teleoperation** – Continued development of low-latency VR control systems using the Luxonis vision stack.
